algorithm: Production SolverNewmark Adaptive: beta=.25 gamma=.5, step doubling, accept two half steps, proportional controller
model: Same two-element CR spatial right-angle frame as CorotationalDynamics/right-angle; T=2.5 s
reference: Existing frozen selfchecked independent DOP853 continuous polynomials; actual accepted times, all nodes and all six state types
reference_scales: Existing frozen reference.csv scales, max(1e-4, component amplitude); rotation uses relative SO(3) angle
qualification: Default shared absolute tolerance is held fixed while relative tolerance changes; a plateau is reported as an unresolved tolerance-floor test, not fixed-step order or proof of an incorrect method. Noncommuting Gauss rotation history contains two accepted substeps, so it cannot be reconstructed from macro-endpoint nodal increments for equilibrium verification.
